frequency_question: How often does the Federal Reserve complete a capital buffer or capital requirement rule change within a standard policy cycle or calendar window of under 18 months from proposal to final release?
membership_rule: Includes all Board of Governors final rulemakings altering bank capital requirements, stress testing parameters, or buffer frameworks; excludes purely technical corrections, temporary relief orders, and routine supervisory guidance not requiring notice-and-comment rulemaking.
